system.description:
Prerequisite: Wiles[2].

Gold Jewelry: Jinxed (Passive): The condition X for this jewelry is Jinxed.

Jewelry (Passive): Gain 1X Advantage against taking the X condition when it is first given to you, as well as on all uses of the “Make Trait Check” action against the specified X condition. The condition X is specified by the type of jewelry (the Jewelry Boons table).

1 Item Slot (Worn, RIS Passive) · 200gc · Jewelry, rulebook p.208
